name: Eastern Plaguelands
_terrain: A 3.3.5 zone Turtle changed in one place: Forlorn Summit (area 5547), a new subzone in the north-western hills above Terrordale and the Plaguewood (Dean LeGuin's academy, its students and failed experiments, Miriam Lenheim). Elsewhere Turtle only adds NPCs and quests (Lake Mereldar, Corin's Crossing, the Thondroril River camp, Light's Hope, Tyr's Hand). The 3.3.5 zone, its NPCs and quests stay.
_merge_region: own=changed: only the Eastern Plaguelands chunks Turtle reshaped or gave a new subzone around Forlorn Summit (Azeroth_36_26, 36_27, 37_26, 37_27). Not taken: Turtle's Thalassian Highlands / Alah'Thalas (5225, 2040: a zone of its own north of the Plaguelands), the Quel'Thalas mountains (2037), Western Plaguelands (28), and the north-east rim (Azeroth_41_25, 42_26, 43_26: unreachable mountains Turtle raised by up to 260 yd above the 3.3.5 ones, next to 3.3.5's Scarlet Enclave, 4012). exclude_chunks: the top half of Azeroth_36_26 and top rows of 37_26 (the Plaguewood / Terrordale north rim): Turtle raised it by up to 70 yd to meet its Thalassian Highlands; left 3.3.5 it meets the 3.3.5 mountains without a cliff.
_exclude_creatures: Turtle systems: training dummies, rented riding mounts. The Arcane Pounder and Defective Arcane Golems (61779, 61778) on the north rim left 3.3.5 (exclude_chunks): they stand on Turtle's raised path to the Thalassian Highlands.
_exclude_gameobjects: Gardening Zone Check, Speedy's Jukebox, Survival's Dead Wood Trees and Gemstone Deposits (Jewelcrafting). The Arcane Crystal Package (2020073, 'Maddening Hunger' 41196, a Thalassian Highlands quest) on the north rim left 3.3.5.
_exclude_quests: Craftsman Wilhelm's Darkforging chain (40234-40237, 40241): it runs through Lorthiras (a Turtle dreadlord in Kalimdor, not ported) and ends at a Turtle Dark-Rune Anvil in Stratholme, rewarding a Turtle-only runeblade. 'A Timely Situation' (80410): it follows Turtle's Caverns of Time chain (80409 'Return to Kheyna', left out with Tanaris' CoT hub). 'The Plaguewood' (41942, Rimblat Earthshatter): it follows 'Duality of Flame' (41941, not in this build) and its Twisted Tree Saplings (object 2020311) are not spawned in Turtle's world DB.
